name: Cryo Blast, Greater
body:
School evocation [cold]; Level druid 3, magus 3, ranger 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3

Area 10-ft. radius burst

DESCRIPTION

This functions as cryo blast, except that it affects all creatures within the area.
